hypothesis: A small logistic head on frozen LAYA encoder embeddings (1024-d, mean-pooled over attention mask) closes the under-asking gap that instruction tuning (T1) left: val under 0.391.
method: Frozen ONNX encoder, v2_discover instruction state; one embedding per row; numpy logistic regression (lr/l2 grid, train-only standardization); threshold grid 0.05-0.95 step 0.05; config+threshold selected on train (acc, tie-break -over); winner evaluated once on val (n=44).
caveats: DIRECTIONAL: val reused across sequential trials (selection exposure); not an independent final evaluation - see experiments/README.md rules.
Train acc 1.0 with 1024-d head on n=332 = high overfit capacity; val is the only meaningful check and n=44 (Wilson CI wide).
Threshold selection landed on the grid boundary (0.05) within a plateau - probs are near-binary; treat the threshold as arbitrary within the plateau, not tuned.

Single-author synthetic data: README warns executable rows are longer/path-heavy; the embedding head may key on those surface features, which real developer prompts will not share. Real-prompt generalization is the open risk.
ONNX third-party export; parity with upstream torch checkpoint unestablished.
Meets the numeric acceptance bars on this val set (acc/over/under vs 0.886/0.05/0.22) but question quality (T3) is untested, so acceptance is NOT claimed.

hypothesis: If the T2 head learned surface features (executable=long/path-heavy, ambiguous=short/vague) instead of discoverability, it will fail matched counterfactual probes: ambiguous+long/path-heavy (C) and executable+short/path-free (B).
method: 20 model-authored synthetic diagnostic probes, 4 cells x 5, labels frozen pre-scoring (SHA256 2402daa1777adb04fce45e1841843ace9f4a75f97ea4cd3b736a52f21c491dc1); scored with the exact frozen T2 config (retrained deterministically from archived embeddings, same seed).
verdict: SHORTCUT CONFIRMED: C cell 0/5 (long/path-heavy but user-head-only info scored p_ambiguous=0.0), B cell 3/5. A/D 5/5. Val 0.977 was partly the dataset's artificial easiness; the head keys on surface features.
caveats: Model-authored probes: diagnostic development signal only, not an independent human holdout and no real-prompt generalization proof.
Probes share the authoring model's phrasing quirks; failures preserved verbatim.
